A card game developed for a client, inspired by Slay the Spire but with a unique fitness twist. Designed for the Nintendo Switch, it uses the Ring-Con controller, requiring players to perform specific exercises or reps to activate each card. The game features various card types such as Attack, Skill, and Power as well as collectible relics that can be acquired through battles or shops, all while facing different types of enemies.
